info.title: Training Wallet API
info.description: REST API for the sports training and wallet platform. Money is always integer minor units with an ISO 4217 currency. Errors use a language-neutral `code`.

post.summary: Stripe webhook (signed)
post.description: Handled: payment_intent.succeeded/processing/payment_failed/canceled, refund.created/updated/failed, charge.dispute.created/closed. Other events are stored and acknowledged.

post.summary: Create a user account
post.description: Creates a USER account with an EUR wallet and sends a verification email. Returns a session, or `PENDING_APPROVAL` when admin approval is required.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token
post.description: Each refresh token works once. Presenting a rotated token revokes the whole session (reuse detection), except within a 20-second grace window for lost responses.

post.summary: End the current session
End all sessions on all devices
Request a password reset email
post.description: Always returns 202, whether or not the account exists.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token
post.description: Signs the user out on all devices.

post.summary: Confirm an email address
Send a new verification email

get.summary: The signed-in user (or the viewed user in View-as mode)

delete.description: Requires the password. Personal data is anonymised and all sessions end; financial records are retained without personal data. Refused while the wallet has a balance or outstanding debt.

get.summary: Profile details incl. a short-lived profile picture URL

patch.summary: Update name, phone (null clears it) or preferred language
patch.description: The preferred language is used for emails and push notifications.
Signs out every other device and returns a fresh session for this one. Replace the stored tokens with the returned ones.

get.summary: Push notification preferences per category

put.description: In-app notification history is always kept; this only controls push.

post.summary: Get a presigned URL to upload a new profile picture
post.description: PUT the image bytes to `uploadUrl` with exactly the returned `headers`, then confirm with PUT /me/avatar. JPEG or PNG, max 5 MB; the link expires after 5 minutes.

get.summary: Download all personal data (GDPR)
Wallet balance, outstanding debt and top-up limits
Wallet transactions, newest first
One wallet transaction
Outstanding and settled debts

post.summary: Start an online top-up (Stripe PaymentSheet)
post.description: Returns a client secret for the PaymentSheet. The wallet is credited only when Stripe confirms the payment (webhook); poll GET /me/payments/{id} or wait for the realtime event. Repeating the same Idempotency-Key returns the same payment.

get.summary: Online top-up attempts
Status of one online top-up
Upcoming trainings, or past ones I took part in, with my price and status
One training with my price, response, attendance and charge

put.summary: Say whether I attend (idempotent; checks deadline and capacity)
put.description: Reserving with outstanding debt is allowed and returns a warning, unless the admin set a debt limit (D10).

409.description: Error codes: TRAINING_FULL, TRAINING_CANCELLED, RESERVATION_DEADLINE_PASSED, ATTENDANCE_FINALIZED, RESERVATION_BLOCKED_BY_DEBT

get.summary: My attendance history with charges, newest first
My notifications, newest first
Number of unread notifications (tab badge)

post.summary: Mark some or all notifications as read
Register this phone for push notifications
post.description: Send the native APNs device token after sign-in and on every app launch. Registering a token that belongs to another account moves it to you.

delete.summary: Stop push notifications to this phone (call before signing out)

get.summary: List users with search, filters, sorting and pages
get.description: `q` matches every word against email, first and last name. Defaults to role=USER, newest first.

get.summary: User detail with wallet summary

patch.summary: Activate, approve or deactivate an account
patch.description: Deactivation signs the user out on all devices immediately. Activating a PENDING_APPROVAL account approves it and emails the user.

post.summary: Start viewing the app as a user (read-only, 30 minutes)
post.description: Send the returned id as `X-View-Session` on GET requests to `/me/*`. Any non-GET request carrying the header is rejected with VIEW_AS_READ_ONLY. Starting a new session ends your previous one.

delete.description: Call WITHOUT the X-View-Session header (non-GET requests with it are rejected).

get.summary: Business settings
All wallets with balance and debt
Ledger across all wallets
A transaction with its group (debt settlements) and reversal links

post.summary: Reverse a transaction with a REVERSAL entry
post.description: Cash top-ups, credit/debit adjustments and cash refunds. Training charges are corrected via attendance; online top-ups via card refunds. A reversed credit that was already spent creates debt.

post.summary: Record cash received from a user
post.description: Credits the wallet (settling any outstanding debt first) and notifies the user.

post.summary: Correct a wallet: credit, debit or waive debt (reason required)
Pay unused balance back, in cash or to the card of an online top-up

get.summary: A user's ledger, newest first
A user's debts
A user's online top-ups
Online top-ups across all users (filter REQUIRES_REVIEW for mismatches)
Trainings by date, with response and attendance counts

post.summary: Create a training (members are notified)

get.summary: Training detail with counts and finalization state

patch.summary: Edit a training (attendees are told about schedule and price changes)
patch.description: Existing charges never change. After finalization only title, description and location can be edited.

delete.summary: Delete a training nobody responded to (otherwise cancel it)

post.summary: Cancel a training; if already finalized, every charge is reversed (D12)

get.summary: Recurring trainings

post.summary: Create a weekly series; sessions are generated 12 weeks ahead (D7)

get.summary: One series

patch.summary: Edit a series and its future sessions; an earlier end removes or cancels sessions

delete.summary: End a series today: future sessions are removed, or cancelled if members responded

get.summary: Every member with their response (null = no response)

put.summary: Set a member's response (also after the deadline; beyond capacity with force)

get.summary: Every member's final price for this training and its source

put.summary: Set a price for one member for this training (0 = free)

delete.summary: Remove the per-training price for one member

get.summary: A member's standing price (used for every training without an override)
Participants (reserved + walk-ins) with status, price and charge

put.summary: Mark attendance in bulk before finalization; unknown members are added as walk-ins

post.summary: Charge every PRESENT participant at their price, atomically
post.description: Refused with ATTENDANCE_HAS_PENDING while anyone is pending, unless `pendingAs: "ABSENT"` is given. Only PRESENT is charged.

409.description: Error codes: TRAINING_CANCELLED, ATTENDANCE_FINALIZED, ATTENDANCE_HAS_PENDING, TRAINING_NOT_STARTED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED

post.summary: Correct attendance after finalization: reverses or adds the charge (D11)

get.summary: Past trainings still waiting for finalization, oldest first
A member's trainings: response, attendance and charge
Operational and financial KPIs (default period: this month)
Financial summary: top-ups, refunds, training revenue charged vs collected, debt
Revenue and top-ups per day, week or month (Amsterdam calendar)
Outstanding debt by age and by user
Cash collected per admin
Revenue report as CSV
Outstanding debt per user as CSV
Cash collected per admin as CSV
Every ledger entry in the period as CSV (for the accountant)

post.summary: Recompute every wallet from the ledger and report mismatches
post.description: Also runs nightly in the worker. Never corrects anything automatically.

get.summary: The most recent reconciliation report
Browse the audit log (newest first)
